25.english_reference: And when Saul heard [ that ] , he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁמַ֣ע שָׁא֔וּל וַ יִּרְדֹּ֥ף אַחֲרֵֽי דָוִ֖ד מִדְבַּ֥ר מָעֽוֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤκουσεν Σαούλ , καὶ κατεδίωξεν ὀπίσω Δαυεὶδ εἰς τὴν ἔρημον Μαάν .
traditions.VUL: quod cum audísset Saul , persecútus est David in desérto Maon .
traditions.KJV: And when Saul heard [ that ] , he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon .

26.english_reference: And Saul went on this side of the mountain , and David and his men on that side of the mountain

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֨לֶךְ שָׁא֜וּל מִ צַּ֤ד הָ הָר֙ מִ זֶּ֔ה וְ דָוִ֧ד וַ אֲנָשָׁ֛י ו מִ צַּ֥ד הָ הָ֖ר מִ זֶּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ πορεύονται Σαοὺλ καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες αὐτοῦ ἐκ μέρους τοῦ ὄρους τούτου , καὶ ἦν Δαυεὶδ καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες αὐτοῦ ἐκ μέρους τοῦ ὄρους τούτου ·
traditions.VUL: Et ibat Saul ad latus montis ex parte una : David autem et viri eius erant in látere montis ex parte áltera .
traditions.KJV: And Saul went on this side of the mountain , and David and his men on that side of the mountain :

26.english_reference: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֨י דָוִ֜ד נֶחְפָּ֤ז לָ לֶ֨כֶת֙ מִ פְּנֵ֣י שָׁא֔וּל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦν Δαυεὶδ σκεπαζόμενος πορεύεσθαι ἀπὸ προσώπου Σαούλ ,
traditions.VUL: Porro David desperábat se posse evádere a fácie Saul :
traditions.KJV: and David made haste to get away for fear of Saul ;

26.english_reference: for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׁא֣וּל וַ אֲנָשָׁ֗י ו עֹֽטְרִ֛ים אֶל דָּוִ֥ד וְ אֶל אֲנָשָׁ֖י ו לְ תָפְשָֽׂ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ Σαοὺλ καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες αὐτοῦ παρενέβαλον ἐπὶ Δαυεὶδ καὶ τοὺς ἄνδρας αὐτοῦ συλλαβεῖν αὐτούς .
traditions.VUL: ítaque Saul et viri eius in modum corónæ cingébant David et viros eius , ut cáperent eos .
traditions.KJV: for Saul and his men compassed David and his men round about to take them .

27.english_reference: But there came a messenger unto Saul , saying

traditions.WLC: וּ מַלְאָ֣ךְ בָּ֔א אֶל שָׁא֖וּל לֵ אמֹ֑ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἄγγελος πρὸς Σαοὺλ ἦλθεν λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et núntius venit ad Saul , dicens :
traditions.KJV: But there came a messenger unto Saul , saying ,

27.english_reference: Haste thee , and come ; for the Philistines have invaded the land

traditions.WLC: מַהֲרָ֣ ה וְ לֵ֔כָ ה כִּֽי פָשְׁט֥וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים עַל הָ אָֽרֶץ
traditions.LXX: Σπεῦδε καὶ δεῦρο , ὅτι ἐπέθεντο οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν .
traditions.VUL: Festína , et veni , quóniam infudérunt se Philísthiim super terram .
traditions.KJV: Haste thee , and come ; for the Philistines have invaded the land .

28.english_reference: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David , and went against the Philistines

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֣שָׁב שָׁא֗וּל מִ רְדֹף֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י דָוִ֔ד וַ יֵּ֖לֶךְ לִ קְרַ֣את פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέστρεψεν Σαοὺλ μὴ καταδιώκειν ὀπίσω Δαυείδ , καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς συνάντησιν τῶν ἀλλοφύλων ·
traditions.VUL: Revérsus est ergo Saul desístens pérsequi David , et perréxit in occúrsum Philisthinórum :
traditions.KJV: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David , and went against the Philistines :

28.english_reference: therefore they called that place Selahammahlekoth

traditions.WLC: עַל כֵּ֗ן קָֽרְאוּ֙ לַ מָּק֣וֹם הַ ה֔וּא סֶ֖לַע הַֽמַּחְלְקֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο ἐπεκλήθη ὁ τόπος ἐκεῖνος Πέτρα ἡ μερισθεῖσα .
traditions.VUL: propter hoc vocavérunt locum illum , Petram dividéntem .
traditions.KJV: therefore they called that place Selahammahlekoth .
